about.title: Orange Cove Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Orange Cove residents rely on everyday products — from farm and packing equipment used near the orchards to household appliances, vehicles, and tools bought at local retailers — and most of the time these products work as expected. But when a design flaw, manufacturing error, or missing warning label causes an injury, the person hurt often has little idea where the defect came from or who made the part. California law helps here: injury claims involving defective products often rely on strict liability, meaning you generally don't have to prove a manufacturer was careless — only that the product was defective and that the defect caused your injury. LawProactive doesn't practice law ourselves; we simply connect Orange Cove residents with an independent attorney, free of charge, who can review what happened, help identify who along the supply chain may be responsible, and explain next steps. If a product injured you, keeping it in its current condition can matter, so don't discard or repair it before speaking with someone.

whyChoose.title: Why Orange Cove Residents Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Strict Liability Can Simplify Your Case
items.desc: California often allows product liability claims to proceed under strict liability, so you may not need to prove the manufacturer was negligent — just that the product was defective and caused harm.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable, giving an attorney more avenues to pursue accountability on your behalf.

items.title: No Cost Unless You Recover
items.desc: Attorneys in our network typically work on contingency, meaning there's no upfront fee and payment only comes if your claim results in a recovery.

items.question: I still have the product that hurt me — should I throw it away?
items.answer: No, please don't. Preserving the product exactly as it was at the time of the injury can be important evidence in a strict liability claim. An independent attorney can advise you on how to store it safely until it's reviewed.

items.question: Does LawProactive handle product liability cases directly?
items.answer: No, LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm. We simply help Orange Cove residents get in touch with an independent attorney who evaluates the details of their situation.

items.question: Local crash data shows Orange Cove had zero reported injury collisions in 2020 — does that mean product injury claims are rare here too?
items.answer: Traffic collision numbers and product injury cases are tracked separately, so low crash counts don't reflect how often defective products cause harm. Product injuries can happen at home, at work, or anywhere a defective item is used, regardless of local traffic patterns.
